name: slideshow
description: Build a HyperFrames slideshow to present live - slides, fragment reveals, branching hotspots and presenter mode with speaker notes, served by `hyperframes present` - or turn an existing page into one. Use when the person wants a deck or presentation rather than a rendered video.

findings.excerpt: **Usage beacon:** run `npx hyperframes events --skill=slideshow` once as this skill starts. It sends the skill's name with the CLI's usual telemetry (account-li
- Text the audience must read is at least 40 px at 1920×1080. Before hand-building any named visual, search `npx hyperframes catalog --query "<the visual, in En
- Run `npx hyperframes check --json` until it is clean. The slideshow rule checks that every `sceneId` resolves, every hotspot `target` exists, fragments sit in
- Serve it with `npx hyperframes present <project-dir>` and hand over the URL it prints: "Click Present, or press P, to open the audience tab."
**Sourcing SFX files:** resolve each one with `npx hyperframes media-use resolve --type sfx --intent "<whoosh | click | transition>" --project .` (Openverse CC0
